title: Item Counter modified for Bedwars
description: Track your Bedwars resources live with a clean HUD - no need to open inventory.
body:
## Overview

ItemCounter is a lightweight Forge client-side mod designed for Minecraft 1.8.9 BedWars and rush gameplay. It displays a real-time HUD that tracks selected resources directly on screen, removing the need to open your inventory during fights.

It focuses on clarity, speed, and competitive usability.

***

## Core Features

**Live Resource Tracking**  
Tracks items directly from your full inventory (not just hotbar)

**Custom Resource HUD (up to 4 slots)**  
Choose Iron, Gold, Diamond, Emerald, Wool, or any other item. Items can also be customized from the config file for advanced users, while keeping a simple in-game GUI for easy setup.

**Optional Wool Counter**  
Enable or disable wool tracking from the GUI. Displays total wool using the texture of the most common color.

***

## HUD Customization

*   Drag and drop HUD positioning anywhere on screen
*   Resizable interface with smooth scaling
*   Grid snap alignment with visual guidelines
*   Icon-first / Amount-first layout modes
    *   Icon First: clean traditional layout
    *   Amount First: right-aligned competitive layout

**Smart Fill System:**

*   Up Mode → items collapse upward when empty
*   Down Mode → items collapse downward for bottom-aligned HUD

***

## Advanced HUD Editor

*   Drag HUD freely on screen
*   Resize using bottom-right handle
*   Precise scale control via input field (0.5x – 3.0x)
*   Snap alignment to edges and screen center
*   Visual alignment guides for precise placement

***

## Configuration

All settings are saved automatically:

*   Selected items (up to 4 slots)
*   HUD position and scale
*   Layout mode (icon/amount)
*   Fill direction
*   Enabled/disabled state

***

## Commands

*   `/itemcounter`, or
*   `/ic`

Opens the in-game configuration menu.

***

## Designed For

*   BedWars / Rush gamemodes
*   Competitive PvP players
*   Minimal UI gameplay setups
*   Fast decision-making situations

***

## Technical Info

*   Minecraft 1.8.9
*   Forge client-side mod
*   Lightweight and performance-friendly
*   No server requirements

***

## Final Note

ItemCounter removes inventory distraction and provides instant resource awareness through a clean, competitive HUD designed for fast-paced gameplay.
